They are evidenced instead by real-DB integration tests (league-match-guest-actions.test.ts, new; match-helper-actions.test.ts, pre-existing) — see C08_OPERATIONAL_ACCEPTANCE.md. Two real findings while building against real production code: (1) guest-add actions had no cancelled-match guard, unlike the equivalent real-Player path — fixed in this branch (league-match-guest-actions.ts's requireMatchNotCancelled()). (2) Guests are entirely absent from the live-reporting pre-match package (getLiveMatchPreMatchPackageAction), so a guest cannot be selected for a live event — a real, disclosed capability gap, too large for this wave's scope, filed as https://github.com/lagebj/matchboard/issues/842, with a regression test documenting current behavior. ADR-0151's document status was corrected from 'Proposed' to 'Accepted' (decisions 1-3 were already fully shipped). Issues #827/#830 remain open, unrelated, untouched — this wave uses its own new, non-shared fixture directory (gate-c/w3-shared/) specifically to avoid re-triggering #827.
